claims: APAC spans East Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania.
APAC encompasses nations ranging from Afghanistan to Pacific island nations and territories.
APAC covers the Western Pacific Ocean.
APAC typically spans from Australia to China and India.
Key countries in APAC include Australia, China, India, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand, Bangladesh.
Major sectors in APAC include technology, finance (banking/investments), manufacturing, logistics, and retail.
The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) manages a specific ICAO APAC Region.
The ICAO APAC Region has 39 contracting states.
The ICAO APAC Region is to regulate air safety.
AIPAC is the American Israel Public Affairs Committee.
In some American political contexts, AIPAC is referred to as a pro-Israel PAC.
In business, regional, and economic contexts, APAC represents the Asia-Pacific area.
